calls.statement:
SELECT 
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE s.store_id = 107
  AND f.sale_date >= '2026-08-31'
  AND f.sale_date <= '2026-09-27'
  AND p.category = 'Cleaning & Household'
  AND s.is_current = true
  AND p.is_current = true

SELECT 
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold,
  MIN(f.sale_date) AS earliest_sale,
  MAX(f.sale_date) AS latest_sale,
  COUNT(*) AS line_count
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE s.store_id = 107
  AND f.sale_date >= '2026-08-31'
  AND f.sale_date <= '2026-09-27'
  AND p.category = 'Cleaning & Household'

SELECT 
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold,
  COALESCE(SUM(r.quantity_returned), 0) AS units_returned,
  SUM(f.quantity) - COALESCE(SUM(r.quantity_returned), 0) AS net_units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
WHERE s.store_id = 107
  AND f.sale_date >= '2026-08-31'
  AND f.sale_date <= '2026-09-27'
  AND p.category = 'Cleaning & Household'

SELECT 
  s.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  p.category,
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
INNER JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar fc ON d.fiscal_year = fc.fiscal_year 
  AND d.fiscal_period = fc.fiscal_period
WHERE s.store_id = 107
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_period = 5
  AND p.category = 'Cleaning & Household'
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, p.category
